access.notes: Free download and installation guide. The solving agent must obtain, install, and set up CASINO or an equivalent open-source Monte Carlo electron transport code.
Standard nuclear decay data: the beta spectrum (energy vs. intensity) of 63Ni can be retrieved from the NNDC NuDat 2 database or equivalent public sources.
Standard physical properties: density ~6.15 g/cm³, atomic composition Ga and N. Available in material databases (e.g., SRIM, ESTAR) or built-in CASINO library.
